title: Strategi Membaca Teks Argumentatif
summary: Advanced reading mechanics for complex discursive texts: unravelling dense syntactic structures, identifying rhetorical discourse markers, recognizing ideological stances, and critical scrutiny.

blocks.html: Advanced Literacy: CEFR B1–B2 Syntactic and Lexical Demands: Parsing academic sentence length, nominalization, passive voice density, and abstract terminology.

blocks.title: Fokus Konsep
blocks.html: Deconstruction of scholarly journal excerpts and policy papers.

blocks.title: Contoh soal sikap penulis
blocks.question: "Although critics claim that remote work reduces teamwork, the evidence so far is mixed, and many teams appear to collaborate effectively online." What is the writer's attitude towards the critics' claim?
steps: Perhatikan kata Although (konsesi) dan the evidence so far is mixed.
Penulis tidak menolak mentah-mentah, tetapi meragukan klaim tersebut dengan hati-hati (appear to).
blocks.answer: Doubtful but careful: the writer questions the claim without rejecting it completely

blocks.question: A question asks: What would most likely happen if the policy in the text were applied nationwide? Which sub-competency does it test?
blocks.hint: Pertanyaan tentang akibat di masa depan.
blocks.explanation: Soal ini meminta memprediksi implikasi atau konsekuensi gagasan: pemahaman inferensial.

blocks.question: "Admittedly, the new railway will disturb some farmland. However, it will cut travel time by half for thousands of workers." What is the function of the first sentence?

options.A: To state the writer's main claim
options.B: To acknowledge a weakness before answering it

blocks.explanation: Admittedly adalah konsesi: penulis mengakui kelemahan, lalu menyanggahnya dengan However.

lessons.title: Decoding Stance, Hedging, and Epistemic Modality

blocks.html: Decoding Stance, Hedging, and Epistemic Modality: Measuring confidence levels conveyed through modal auxiliaries ('may', 'would seem', 'arguably').

blocks.title: Hedging dan boosting
blocks.html: Kata seperti may, might, could, suggest, appear, likely menunjukkan penulis berhati-hati. Kata seperti clearly, undoubtedly, must, prove, always menunjukkan penulis yakin sekali. Soal tentang sikap penulis (attitude, tone, position) sering bisa dijawab dari pilihan kata ini.
